cases.oracle: Locked util-linux ionice, with independent Linux x86-64 ioprio_get/set read-back for fixture-owned processes.
cases.comparison: Exact status, output and independently read I/O class/data. Explicit aliases are adapted to the canonical GNU spelling where stated.
cases.script:
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
/usr/bin/python3 worker.py one 0 0 & child=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$child" 2>/dev/null; wait "$child" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 ready.py one || exit 90
ionice -n 0 -c none -p "$child"; printf "status=%s\n" "$?"
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import ioprio,sys;print("ioprio=%s,%s"%ioprio.get(int(sys.argv[1])))' "$child"

files.worker.py:
import pathlib,signal,sys
import ioprio
label=sys.argv[1];ioprio.set(0,int(sys.argv[2]),int(sys.argv[3]))
pathlib.Path('ready-'+label).write_text('ready\n')
signal.alarm(15)
while True:signal.pause()

cases.stderr: ionice: ignoring given class data for none class
